# Nord Anglia Education

> A global network of 80+ premium international day and boarding schools delivering academic excellence through world-class teaching, innovative partnerships with institutions like Juilliard and MIT, and transformative student experiences.

Nord Anglia Education operates one of the world's largest networks of international schools across Europe, Asia, the Americas, and the Middle East. The organization is committed to academic excellence, student wellbeing, and global citizenship through collaborative partnerships and cutting-edge learning environments.
